results.change_intent: Add a Node.js script to download translation files from the POEditor API and save them as JSON in a temporary directory.
results.summary: The script handles POEditor download and normalization, but has unused imports and non-English comments.

issues.comment: `__filename` is defined using `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` along with the `fileURLToPath` import, but neither is ever used in the script.
issues.suggestion: Remove the unused `__filename` variable and the `fileURLToPath` import from `url`.

issues.comment: Comments are written in Turkish while the rest of the codebase and file comments use English.
issues.suggestion: Translate comments to English for consistency across the codebase.

results.change_intent: Document the POEditor translation synchronization workflow, required settings, and manual execution options.
results.summary: Documentation accurately reflects workflow behavior, though default language mentions are slightly inconsistent across files.

results.change_intent: Add a GitHub Actions workflow to periodically or manually download POEditor translations and push changes back to the repository.
results.summary: The workflow will fail on push due to missing write permissions and checkout depth, and has an inconsistency in language defaults.

issues.comment: By default, `GITHUB_TOKEN` only has read permissions in modern GitHub repositories unless explicitly granted write permissions. Step `git push` on line 92 will fail with 403 Forbidden without `contents: write` permission declared on the job or workflow.
issues.suggestion: Add explicit `permissions: { contents: write }` to the job or workflow.
issues.suggested_code:
jobs:
  sync-translations:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

issues.evidence:
- name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
issues.comment: `actions/checkout@v3` (and later) defaults to `fetch-depth: 1`, creating a shallow clone. Pushing commits directly back to the branch from a shallow clone without fetching or checking out the branch ref can result in push rejection or history divergence.
issues.suggestion: Specify `fetch-depth: 0` in `actions/checkout` or ensure the target branch is explicitly checked out before committing and pushing.
issues.suggested_code:
- name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

issues.comment: Inconsistent language codes are used: `workflow_dispatch.inputs.languages.default` defaults to `tr,en` and `download-translations.js` defaults to `tr,en`, but the fallback in line 60 uses `'tr,gb'` (which is also mentioned in the README). When scheduled via cron, `github.event.inputs.languages` will be empty, triggering `tr,gb` instead of `tr,en`.
issues.suggestion: Align the default language code fallback across the workflow, documentation, and download script (e.g. consistently use `en` or `gb`).
